page_title: NIC 1-0 NAN | Nice v Nantes 13/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) takes the corner which is cleared.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
86' Here comes a substitution. Nicolas Cozza is given a rest as he is replaced by Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes).
86' Luis Castro has decided to make a change. Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) replaces Mostafa Mohamed.
83' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Nantes.
81' We are about to witness a subsitution. Tom Louchet (Nice) for Hicham Boudaoui.
77' Today's match ends for Junior Mwanga who will be replaced by Mayckel Lahdo (Nantes).
75' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Dante will be replaced by Tiago Gouveia (Nice).
75' Substitution. Jeremie Boga makes way for Isak Jansson (Nice).
70' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) has a goal ruled out for offside!
69' Nantes seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
67' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:2.
65' It's time for a substitution. Louis Leroux (Nantes) comes on in place of Hyun-Seok Hong.
63' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Nice.
62' Franck Haise prepares a substitution. Sofiane Diop is replaced by Morgan Sanson (Nice).
62' The referee signals a substitution. Terem Moffi (Nice) is brought on as a substitute for Kevin.
58' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
57' Sofiane Diop (Nice) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.

56' 1 - 0 Jeremie Boga (Nice) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Anthony Lopes is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
55' Nantes are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
53' 65:35 – the ratio of ball possession.
52' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
50' That was close by Matthis Abline (Nantes)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
48' The Nice players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Yassine Benhattab (Nantes) comes off for Amady Camara.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nantes.
45+1' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Matthis Abline (Nantes), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
45+1' The ball goes out for a corner. Nantes can continue in their attacking effort.
45+1' Matthis Abline (Nantes) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Juma Bah (Nice) is penalised.
42' Great teamplay by Nice as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
40' Jeremie Boga (Nice) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Sofiane Diop, but Anthony Lopes displays great awareness to stop him.
39' Jeremie Boga (Nice) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
38' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 1:0.
37' Kevin (Nice) commits a foul during an attacking move.
35' Kevin (Nice) latches onto a cross and shoots from close-range, but Anthony Lopes makes a terrific save to deny him.
35' The Nice players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
34' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
32' Nantes control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
31' 3:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.

28' Golden opportunity! Jeremie Boga (Nice) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
27' The ball is cleared after Yassine Benhattab (Nantes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
27' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
24' Neat passing move from Nice in order to create new attacking opportunities.
23' Nice can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
20' Sofiane Diop (Nice) receives a pass on the edge of the box and attempts a lob as the keeper is off his line, but the effort crashes off the left post.
18' Hyun-Seok Hong (Nantes) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads low to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
18' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Anthony Lopes is equal to it and makes an easy save.
17' Jeremie Boga (Nice) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
14' The Nantes players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
13' Nice take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
10' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
10' An attempted cross from Jeremie Boga (Nice) is cleared.
9' Nice work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
8' Melvin Bard (Nice) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Nice win a corner kick.
6' Nice have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
6' Sofiane Diop (Nice) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
3' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) swings in a cross from the corner, but Anthony Lopes reads it well and gathers the ball.
2' Kevin (Nice) meets an accurate cross in the box and steers a fine header towards the net. The goalkeeper has to react quickly to keep the ball out.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Nantes will have the kick-off.
Guillaume Paradis will officiate today.
